title: Integrate streaming transactional model verification and staging into production installation
goal: Model download publishing in transactional_download::Store is uncalled by production commands; finish() reads full artifacts into memory via std::fs::read risking OOM on multi-GB weights; production managed installation lacks streaming checksum verification, staged-to-ready atomic transition, and disk-full recovery. Acceptance requires a test that exercises the production path, not the module in isolation: this task was filed with the vector's mastery test as its acceptance, and that test passes today because the module already satisfies its own semantics - which is why the task could be closed without the integration it asks for. The named test does not exist yet, and is the work.
